instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Run tool:rank-library-formats-against-concepts", and give it step.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:rank-library-formats-against-concepts and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: An answer with the fields step, candidates, concepts, palette, distinct_in_options, settings_from.

worked_examples.hands_back: An answer with the fields step, candidates, concepts, palette, distinct_in_options, settings_from.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
